NEW kb/false-alarms.json entry `fa-2026-11-26-haydenfire1-mapbox-style-fetch-abort-on-map-unmount-xhr-noise`: monitor 77419271 Warn 21:26Z on haydenfire1 (recovered 21:27Z). 46 of 46 XHR errors were `GET api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/mapbox/streets-v11`, status 0, with stack `AbortError` at Map.remove -> setStyle. The map control cancels its own style fetch when it unmounts. 81 of 82 errors in 21-22Z came from ONE user session on one screen. 0 server-side errors, 0 other XHR errors. Rejected the ki-2026-05-21 match: it hit only on the generic title and monitor id, and none of these are gateway paths.
Follow-ups: (1) exclude *api.mapbox.com* from 77419271 the way segment/mixpanel are; (2) about 80 map remounts in one session suggests a re-render loop in the m-one map widget.
